description: Spring MVC and WebFlux: what a project sets in configuration code that decides its routes, and the profile key that declares it instead.

rules.description: RequestMappingHandlerMapping.setPathPrefixes and PathMatchConfigurer.addPathPrefix (in Spring MVC and in WebFlux) serve the controllers a predicate picks under a path prefix. The predicate is a lambda over the controller class and the prefix is often read from a property, so no reading of the source can say either. A call to one of them means the routes this pack records may lack their prefix, and the profile's pathPrefixes key is where a project says what they are. A declared key is taken as the project's word; the call is only said when the key is empty.
rules.why: ruoyi-vue-pro serves every admin controller under /admin-api and every app controller under /app-api, from setPathPrefixes in YudaoWebAutoConfiguration with both values defaulted in WebProperties. Every route was recorded without its prefix, and nothing said why.

params.effect: the controllers it picks are served under a path prefix, and every route of theirs is recorded here without it

calls.why: the handler mapping itself, told a map of prefix to predicate: the form a project uses when it builds its own mapping
the public way, from WebMvcConfigurer.configurePathMatch or WebFluxConfigurer.configurePathMatching

examples.why: the shape ruoyi-vue-pro writes: a mapping built inside a WebMvcRegistrations and told its prefixes, on a local
at the end of a chain on a parameter, and the line is the one the name is written on
